description: This Java class implements a MiniLang method operation <session-to-field>, which transfers a session attribute value into a specified field within the method context, with support for default values. It includes validation, construction, execution logic, and a factory class for instantiation.

classes.name: SessionToField
classes.description: Implements a method operation that copies a session attribute into a specified field in the method context, possibly with a default value if the attribute is absent or empty.

classes.name: SessionToField.SessionToFieldFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of the <session-to-field> method operation.

methods.name: SessionToField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation based on the provided XML element and method context, validating attributes and preparing expression expanders and map accessors.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the <session-to-field> operation by retrieving the session attribute value and assigning it to the specified field, defaulting if necessary.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the operation, including its attributes.
